pr_title: [Windows] Add Windows version and Wine checks for Windows 10+ dark mode API.

issue_context.title: Godot editor crashes under Linux with Wine
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: 4.3 dev4 ~ 4.3 beta1
- Not Reproducible: 4.3 dev3, 4.2.2

### System information

OS: Fedora 38, Kernel 6.8.9-100.fc38.x86_64, Wine 9.0/9.3

### Issue description

Godot editor crashes when trying to run it with Wine 9.0 under linux.

In 4.3 dev4, the editor crashed silently. In 4.3 beta1, the editor crashed with message:
